name: kdtree_default
_comment: maxDepth raised 12 -> 22 on 2026-08-16. A binary tree capped at depth 12 has at most 2^12 = 4096 leaves NO MATTER how many points it holds, so leafCapacity never bound above ~131k points and this schema was benchmarked as a depth cap rather than as a kd-tree. Measured at 25M it held 6103 points per leaf and tested 8164 points per query, against the octree default's 210 - which is where most of the reported gap to the Indexicon baseline came from. At 22 levels (4.2M leaves) leafCapacity binds through the whole searched ladder (1M-100M); above 250M it degrades gracefully instead of collapsing. Tuned singles were never affected, they already carry proper depths.
